verses.text: <pb/><t>Òle ebe onye ihe-ya nātọ gi utọ jeworo,</t> <t>Gi onye mara nma n'etiti ndinyom?</t> <t>Òle ebe onye ihe-ya nātọ gi utọ cheworo iru,</t> <t>Ka ayi we soro gi chọ ya? <pb/></t>
<t>Onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ aridaruwo ubi-ya ab͕ara ogige, rue nkpuru nile nke uda,</t> <t>Izù ìgwè aturu-ya n'ubi-ya nile ab͕ara ogige, na ichikọta urodi.</t>
<t>Mu onwem bu nke onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ, onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ bu kwa nkem:</t> <t>Bú onye ahu nke nāzù ìgwè aturu-ya n'etiti urodi. <pb/></t>
<t>Onye mara nma ka i bu, eyìm, dika Tiaza,</t> <t>I mara nma nke-uku dika Jerusalem,</t> <t>I bu onye anātu ujọ dika usu-ndi-agha chi ọkọlọtọ.</t>
<t>Wepu anya-gi abua n'irum,</t> <t>N'ihi na ha onwe-ha akpaliwom elu.</t> <t>Agiri-isi-gi di ka ìgwè ewu,</t> <t>Nke nēdina ala n'akuku ugwu Gilead.</t>
<t>Ezé-gi di ka ìgwè nne-aturu,</t> <t>Nke siworo n'isa-aru rigota;</t> <t>Nke ha nile chi umu abua umu abua,</t> <t>Ọ dighi kwa nke b͕a aka nwa n'etiti ha.</t>
<t>Dika iberibe pomegranate ka akuku egedege-iru-gi bu</t> <t>N'azu ákwà-nkpuchi-gi.</t>
<t>Ọgu eze-nwanyi atọ di, ọgu ndinyom anọ, nke bu iko, di kwa,</t> <t>Na umu-ab͕ọghọ nādighi ọnu-ọgugu.</t>

<t>Nání otù ka ọ bu, bú ndurum, onye nkem nke zuru okè;</t> <t>Nání otù nwa nne-ya muru ka ọ bu;</t> <t>Onye arọputara arọputa nke nwanyi muru ya nwere ka ọ bu.</t> <t>Umu-ndinyom huru ya, we si na ọ bu onye ihe nāgara nke-ọma;</t> <t>E, ọgu eze-nwanyi atọ ahu na ọgu ndinyom anọ ahu, bú iko, ha we to ya. <pb/></t>
<t>Ònye bu nwanyi a nke nēlepu anya dika ututu,</t> <t>Nke mara nma dika ọnwa,</t> <t>Nēnwu ka anyanwu,</t> <t>Onye anātu ujo dika usu-ndi-agha chi ọkọlọtọ? <pb/></t>
<t>Rue ubi walnut ab͕ara ogige ka m'ridara,</t> <t>Ilekwasi akwukwọ ndu nke ndagwurugwu anya,</t> <t>Ihu ma osisi vine amawo ifuru,</t> <t>Na ihu ma osisi pomegranate ab͕awawo okoko.</t>
<t>Mb͕e m'kāmaghi, nkpuru-obim dorom</t> <t>N'etiti ub͕ọ-ala nke ndim amara aha-ya. <pb/></t>
<t>Lata, lata, gi nwanyi Shulam;</t> <t>Lata, lata, ka ayi we lekwasi gi anya.</t> <t>Gini mere unu gēji lekwasi nwanyi Shulam anya,</t> <t>Dika ilekwasi otite-egwú nke Mahanaim?</t>
